text:
Kestrel planning meetings (3–10 Nov) set configuration, dependencies, and worker assignments across about 26 modules. Key decisions:

- **Client requirements:** cache retry_limit 3, catalog retry_limit 8, gateway batch_size 250.
- **Corrected values:** cache ttl_s 360; upload ttl_s 570 and timeout_s 85; webhooks timeout_s 50; session queue_depth 50; auth retry_limit 5; catalog batch_size 200; export queue_depth 420; checkout timeout_s 75.
- **Ordering:** gateway before auth; metrics before indexer; cache before audit; checkout before returns.
- **Constraints:** audit/returns, catalog/ingest, and alerts/ledger run on separate workers; no dependency path from metrics to catalog; auth can't depend on catalog; gateway can't depend on webhooks; ingest can't depend on pricing.
- **Open items:** security review at month-end; budget review moved to next Thursday; on-call rota changes next month; Maya is on leave next week.
